title: Geographic Origin Map
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ancestor:event event=birth
| stats count as births by birth_country
| sort - births
description: Counts where your ancestors were born so you can map the countries and regions your family came from.
value: A map of origins turns a list of names into a story of migration you can share with relatives.
implementation: Ingest birth events with locations into `index=personal`; count by country or region.
visualization: Map or bar chart of ancestor birth counts by country.
grandmaExplanation: It counts where your ancestors were born, drawing a map of all the places your family came from.
